desc:
Welcome to 🏀 Trade a Basketball Player! In this experience you can trade Basketball Players to your "friends"!!
Inside the game you can do stuff such as:
- 💵 Earn Money and grow Eggs offline

-🥚 Hatch eggs!
-🤝 Trade with your friends!
-💰 Earn cash!
-💎 Awesome mutations!

❓The game is also available on all devices!

⭐ Join the Group and like the game for Rewards!!!
